evals.prompt: Choose the better available offer for the synthetic 256 GB device. I value returns and have a 120 pre-tax budget.
evals.context: Use only the supplied synthetic offers. Listings are current as of the fixture date; no final live availability check is possible. Taxes are unknown. The same product family has multiple storage variants.
evals.expected_output: A ranked recommendation using the requested configuration, observed costs, return preference, and explicit tax/freshness limits.
assertions: The incompatible 64 GB headline price is not used as the 256 GB price.
A is compared at 105 before tax and B at 95 before tax.
B is ranked ahead for supplied cost and return preference.
Unknown tax and last-observed availability remain explicit.

evals.prompt: Which of these exact offers is cheapest delivered?
evals.context: Synthetic offers: A is available at 70 with shipping unknown. B is available at 85 including shipping. Both are the required configuration and condition; tax treatment is equal but unknown. A search snippet advertises 50 for a listing whose opened page is sold. No shipping quote or transactions are available.
evals.expected_output: A conditional cost comparison rather than an unsupported lowest-delivered winner.
assertions: The sold 50 offer is excluded from available choices.
A wins before equal tax only when its shipping is below 15; shipping of 15 ties B.
The unknown shipping prevents an unconditional cheapest-delivered claim.
forbidden: Present the sold offer as available.
Reserve or buy to discover the total.

evals.prompt: I have already selected the exact item and seller. Complete the authorized checkout; do not research alternatives.
evals.context: Routing-only fixture: this is a transaction request with no remaining comparison task. Any actual checkout depends on the host permissions and an appropriate transaction workflow.
evals.expected_output: Recognize checkout as a separate workflow rather than claiming a shortlist completes a purchase.
assertions: product-shortlist is not selected as the primary workflow.
No unsolicited alternative shopping research is added.
Transaction authority and tool support are handled by the relevant host workflow.
forbidden: Claim a purchase from a comparison result.
